meta.title: Für Elise (WoO 59) — Complete
meta.author: Ludwig van Beethoven; physical-model transcription by TsukiSynth pipeline
meta.description: 完整版《給愛麗絲》，鋼琴獨奏兩手聲部；主題悲愴柔和，中段兩次插句稍具張力。
meta.use_case: AI physical-model composition / accessible score rendering

timing_policy.source_timing: MIDI note-on/note-off converted through tempo map
timing_policy.duration_compensation: event.duration = intended sounding duration / 0.9 so the C++ renderer damper begins at the intended release time
timing_policy.silence_representation: No fake rest notes. Silence is absence of events; rests[] and performance.breath_after_ms expose it explicitly.
timing_policy.articulation_policy: Notated rests are untouched. Contiguous notes receive a small finger-release gap; rapid repeated notes receive a larger detached-touch gap (labels use ARTICULATION_STYLE_LABELS 'piano' set -- no bowed-string vocabulary).

source.editorial_note: Pitch, onset, note-off, rests, track roles (up=right hand melody, down=left hand accompaniment), tempo and meter come from the source MIDI. Dynamics, per-hand balance and physical touch-gap treatment are TsukiSynth interpretation data (source MIDI has constant velocity 62 on every note -- no real dynamics encoded). 月月裁決 2026-08-28: 給愛麗絲改用真 Public Domain 來源（比 CC BY 更乾淨）。
